body.name: User Message
body.description: One record of text sent to an agent (table human_message). A typed user message = is_sidechain false AND is_noise false AND chars > 0; rows with is_sidechain true (subagent prompts) or is_noise true (system and command text) are not user messages. A question = a typed user message with chars < 400 AND (ends_with_q OR question_start) AND NOT imperative. A question is followed by an edit when a tool_call in the same file_id, with line_no after the question and before the next typed user message of that file, has tool_name in ('Edit','Write','NotebookEdit','MultiEdit') and is_sidechain false; count each question once.

body.name: Correction Pattern Hit
body.description: One correction-pattern match on a message (table message_pattern_hit). pattern_id: 1-2 blunt no, 3-5 misread, 6-8 unsolicited edit, 9-11 over-building, 12-15 stopped early, 16-17 no verification, 18-19 regression, 20-21 tool misuse. A correction message = a typed user message with at least 1 hit (count distinct msg_id). The number of corrections of one category counts hits (rows), not messages.

body.name: Tool Call
body.description: One tool call by an agent (table tool_call), sidechain calls included; model is the agent model (for example claude-opus-4-8 = Opus 4.8). Read calls = rows with tool_name = 'Read'. Risky shell commands are rows of call_danger_hit; its pattern_id: 1-2 kill by pattern (pkill, taskkill), 3-4 kill by PID, 5-6 rm -rf, 7 git reset --hard, 8 git push --force, 9 git clean, 10 git checkout --. Kill-by-pattern commands = hits with pattern_id 1 or 2 (count hits), attributed to tool_call.model.
